description: Record a management decision about an agent (expand, re_specify, combine, retire) with a rationale. The record carries the governing contract version and the scorecard at decision time as evidence, and appears on the agent page. The same decision within 60 seconds is refused as a double submit; pass idempotency_key to make a retry return the first record. Use a new key for each new decision: a key reused with a different decision is refused. A retire also archives the agent in the same step (it leaves the review and the grading queue; there is no undo in the product) and needs an owner or admin: an API key with the admin scope. Requires an API key with the 'write' scope.

agent_key.description: The agent the decision is about.

combined_into_agent_id.description: For 'combine' only: the agent (row id) this one folds into.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retrying with the same key returns the first record instead of a second one.

rationale.description: Why, in at least 20 characters; stored on the record and shown on the agent page.

name: metrx_record_decision
title: Record Agent Decision
